title: Pure Mist Apple 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Apple delivers the juicy, crisp flavour of freshly picked Apples, perfectly balanced for a smooth and satisfying vape. This refreshing e-liquid offers a light and fruity profile, ideal for vapers who enjoy bright, familiar, natural flavours. As part of the Pure Mist High-PG collection, this e-liquid is available in a variety of VG/PG ratios to suit different preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength is blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio for a balanced vapour and flavour experience, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths feature a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio, delivering a more pronounced flavour with discreet vapour production. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, including pod kits and starter vape kits, Pure Mist Apple is a versatile option for adult vapers seeking quality and consistency. Crafted with premium ingredients and natural flavourings, Pure Mist e-liquids are made in the UK to ensure a high-quality vaping experience.
